name: Hinode (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Hinode town emblem in white: a ring crossed by a curved band, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Hinode, a town in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 June 1974.

features.role: Hinode town emblem — a ring crossed by a curved band, like a stylised character
